title: Whiteboard-mod
description: Add a interactive drawing and real-time collaboration for Fabric.
body: # Whiteboard Interactive drawing and real-time collaboration for Fabric. ## Features * **3D Block Model**: Custom whiteboard block that automatically faces the player on placement. * **Interactive GUI**: Right-click to open a dedicated drawing interface. * **Multiplayer Sync**: Real-time stroke synchronization across all players. * **Standard Integration**: Requires an axe to mine quickly; drops as an item when broken. ## Media ### The Whiteboard in game ### Interactive Drawing UI ## Crafting The Whiteboard is crafted using sticks and paper: ## License This project is licensed under the **MIT License**.
